pr_comments:
A quick look at Japanese text and it does fix the immediate issue with dropping characters.  However, looking at GUITextLayout I Can't say we are doing a great job wrapping text.  For example, I see line break before IDEOGRAPHIC FULL STOP U+3002.

At some point it might be worth looking at Unicode UAX#14 line break algorithm.  It can be tailored for our use case which doesn't require support for every possible unicode script/language.
